verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway documents a dedicated 'AI MCP Server' entity and 'AI MCP Proxy' plugin that let you turn any API into an official MCP server or front upstream MCP servers, with enterprise-grade auth, security, and observability for MCP traffic that agents connect through (docs-13, docs-19, docs-36, docs-45). This is first-party documented as a first-class capability, not a workaround. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs and no live probe confirming the entity in a running deployment.
